title: Early Defibrillation by Smartphone-based Community First Responders in Out-of-hospital Cardiac Arrest: A Prospective Interventional Study (Early-Shock-OWL Trial)
summary: This study evaluates whether equipping Smartphone-based Community First Responders (SCRFs) in the Gütersloh district with automated external defibrillators (AEDs) significantly reduces the time to first rhythm analysis and defibrillation in out-of-hospital cardiac arrests (OHCA) compared to standard EMS response. The project is conducted in two sequential phases: control (CFRs without AED) and intervention (CFRs with AEDs), assessing impact on key resuscitation metrics.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- All adult patients with OHCA
- Resusciation measures performed (Chest compressions and/or defibrillation) in accordance with Utstein criteria
Exclusion criteria:
Patients < 18 years of age
Abscence of OHCA
No resusication performed (e.g., clear signs of death, rigor mortis, livor mortis)
Presence of do-not-resuscitate (DNR) order
Traumatic cardiac arrest
No CFR alerted
